name: Jesus Is God
overview: Scripture clearly reveals the divine nature of Jesus Christ, affirming that He is God incarnate. Isaiah prophesies the coming Messiah as 'The mighty God' and 'The everlasting Father,' while the Gospel of John identifies Jesus as the eternal Word who was both with God and was God, becoming flesh to dwell among humanity. Jesus’ own declaration, 'Before Abraham was, I am,' and His statement, 'I and my Father are one,' affirm His unity with the Father. Thomas’ confession, calling Jesus 'My Lord and my God,' further confirms the recognition of Jesus’ deity by His followers.
